SAVE this post and try it for yourself 💯🙌

1. Cable Step Ups 20,15,12,10
2. Kneeling Cable Kick Backs 4x20
3. Machine Hip Thrusts 4x10
4. Side Leg Press 4x12
5. 45deg Back Extensions 4x15

Otherwise be sure to download @liftit.app and get yourself on a proper program 📲

If you’re looking for more workouts like this and have the goal of building your glutes…

I’d suggest starting with my High Tension Glutes Program 🔥

#bodybuildingwomen #fitnesscoaching #workoutreels".
